research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Okera is researching enhancements for operating data access application services, as described in Data Retrieval Using Distributed Workers in a Large-Scale Data Access System, which details methods for handling client requests in distributed environments. Additionally, Systems and methods for a virtual sandbox database focuses on management of big data storage and data access control systems, including sandbox databases for users. These areas reflect Okera’s focus on secure and scalable data authorization solutions.

overview_description.description: Okera provides secure data access at scale so that data teams have the confidence to unlock the power of their data for innovation and growth. By ensuring that appropriate data access controls are in place and meet the evolving data privacy landscape, the Okera Active Data Access Platform can automatically discover and audit data lakes, create access policies using its no-code visual policy engine, and enforce fine-grained access in hybrid and multi-cloud environments such as AWS and Azure. Okera is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, ClearSky Security, and Felicis Ventures.

product.name: OkeraEnsemble
product.description: A platform for analyzing both structured and unstructured data with integrated data security and compliance features.

product.name: Discover & Classify Sensitive Data
product.description: Uses AI to automatically classify sensitive data across columns and files, supporting compliance and security efforts.

product.name: Data Governance for AI
product.description: Provides a self-service platform for managing fine-grained data access control policies, enhancing data security for AI applications.

product.name: Accelerate Regulatory Compliance Reporting
product.description: Facilitates compliance reporting by providing insights into data usage, access patterns, and enforcement of least privilege access principles.

product.name: De-Identifying Sensitive Data
product.description: Guidance on formatting data to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access, supporting privacy and compliance.
